verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing pages state two safeguards: multi-layered digital protection, including 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication, and opening and scanning done in facilities the provider operates with access controls. Both are one-line claims rather than detailed security documentation, and staff screening is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: any documentation of staff screening or background checks, detail on what the facility controls actually are, explicit confirmation that scans are encrypted at rest and in transit, compliance attestations, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, the provider documents how mail is physically secured and digitally protected — facility controls, staff screening, encryption of scans

citations.quote: Keep your business mail secure with multi-layered protection, including 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication.
Keep sensitive mail handling in trusted hands with opening and scanning completed in facilities we operate with access controls.
